dogecoin.text: Very disappointed in @elonmusk today. Thought he was for the people but clearly not. I've heard and seen a few things about him of late and I can assure you I will never buy a Tesla whether with dogecoin,  Bitcoin, fiat or any other currency. Waster!
The world's a fucked up place when one person buys twitter and your Dogecoin jumps 22% . I just wanna go back to living in the woods.
